Title: Generally available: Azure Stream Analytics in 10 new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Stream Analytics is now generally available in 10 new regions:

  • Australia Central 2
  • Brazil Southeast
  • France South
  • Germany North
  • West India
  • Korea South
  • Norway West
  • Sweden Central
  • Sweden South
  • Switzerland West

With this announcement, Stream Analytics is now available in 48 Azure regions worldwide. For more information about local pricing, visit the Azure Stream Analytics pricing webpage.
